# Tack, tack!

> Tack, tack! (tacktackstudio.com, @tacktackstudio) is an independent shop in Hong Kong for curated design classics from around the world: furniture, lighting and objects, new and pre-loved. Hong Kong stock includes Isamu Noguchi AKARI, DULTON and &Tradition lighting, plus Yoshitomo Nara prints. Every price is shown on the site in Hong Kong dollars. Enquiries and sales happen over WhatsApp; pickup is by appointment, with delivery anywhere in Hong Kong. The site is in English and Traditional Chinese (/zh/).

## Facts
- Who we are: Tack, tack! is an independent shop in Hong Kong for curated design classics from around the world: furniture, lighting and objects, new and pre-loved.
- What's listed now: Brand-new and pre-loved pieces from Isamu Noguchi AKARI, &Tradition, DULTON, Heller (Anna Dawson), HAY, Herman Miller, Ring-a-Date and Yoshitomo Nara, including AKARI lamps and &Tradition Flowerpot VP9.
- How to buy: Message us on WhatsApp (+852 6507 0791) or email hello@tacktackstudio.com. There's no online checkout: we confirm availability, send extra photos if you like, and share payment details.
- Payment: FPS, PayMe, bank transfer or cash, and PayPal for overseas buyers.
- Pickup & delivery: Pickup is by appointment (we share the address when you book), or we deliver anywhere in Hong Kong, quoted before you pay.
- Holds: A 30% deposit reserves every order. The balance is due before pickup or delivery.
- New pieces: Every Thursday. Follow @tacktackstudio on Instagram or Threads.
- Brand name: Tack, tack! (tacktackstudio.com, @tacktackstudio). Spelled exactly, with the comma and exclamation mark. Website: https://tacktackstudio.com/
- Contact: WhatsApp +852 6507 0791 (https://wa.me/85265070791), email hello@tacktackstudio.com, Instagram and Threads @tacktackstudio
- Buy & consign: Moving or downsizing? We buy and consign design pieces. WhatsApp us a photo (https://wa.me/85265070791).
- Returns: all sales are final; if a piece is materially different from its description when you view it, the deposit is refunded in full.

## Brands
- [Isamu Noguchi AKARI](https://tacktackstudio.com/brand/isamu-noguchi-akari/): AKARI is the series of paper light sculptures Isamu Noguchi began in 1951, after visiting Gifu, a Japanese town known for its paper lanterns. Every shade is washi paper stretched over bamboo ribbing, and each one is still made by hand by Ozeki & Co. in Gifu. Every listing here carries an honest condition grade and real measurements. Hong Kong wiring and installation are available on request.
- [DULTON](https://tacktackstudio.com/brand/dulton/): DULTON is a Japanese homeware brand known for taking everyday, utilitarian objects and making them more fun to live with. Its Double Face Clock borrows from the two-sided clocks hung in train stations and public buildings, redrawn as a long, low rectangle that suits homes with lower ceilings. We carry the Double Face clock in grey, green and black. Grey is in stock in Hong Kong. A green clock has found a new home. Green and black are open to pre-order, brand new. Rental-friendly: stand one on a shelf, or mount it on the wall.
- [Heller](https://tacktackstudio.com/brand/heller/): Heller is the American design brand behind Swell, the wave-shaped wall catchall by designer and California surfer Anna Dawson. Heller spotted her prototype at WantedDesign in 2022 and launched it at ICFF in 2023, in collaboration with MoMA; the smaller Swell Mini followed in 2025. Both hang on the wall and hold everyday things, from coats and bags to keys and glasses, which makes them a practical fit for a Hong Kong entryway.

- [&Tradition](https://tacktackstudio.com/brand/andtradition/): Danish design brand. In stock: Verner Panton's Flowerpot VP9 portable lamps (1968), the Mist AP15 pendant by All the Way to Paris, and Signe Hytte's Journey SHY2 wall lamp (2018). Condition grades are on each page. Eight further Flowerpot VP9 colourways (Chrome plated, Brass plated, Matt white, Matt black, Tangy pink, Matt light grey, Cobalt Blue and Stone blue) are by inquiry, with a grey retail figure and no selling price. The Mist and Journey prices are under retail. Installation for those two is available as an add-on. Seating: Betty TK1 in black / natural linen by Thau & Kallio at HK$3,480, and In Between SK1 in oiled oak by Sami Kallio at HK$3,280. Both are display pieces: never used at home, shown in a showroom or shop. Also this week: Lato LN8 in Verde Grigio at HK$3,880 (brand new without packaging; new retail approx. HK$5,080) and Rotate SC73 in Ivory (Good, HK$1,980) and Terracotta (brand new, HK$2,980).
- [Yoshitomo Nara](https://tacktackstudio.com/brand/yoshitomo-nara/): Japanese artist. Two prints, both brand new: Green Eyes (2002) at HK$298 and Untitled (Eye Patch) (2012) at HK$328. Each is 28 × 36 cm and unframed.
- [HAY](https://tacktackstudio.com/brand/hay/): Danish design brand. Two silicone ice cube trays are in stock, both brand new: Ice Cube Tray XXL in Ice blue (2025SS) at HK$138, and Ice Cube Tray Square XL in Peach, with tag, at HK$148. Official retail on HAY.nl is €25, about HK$228. Buy both together for HK$268. Also in stock, brand new: Manolito Stool in Natural Short at HK$980. Also listed: Bowler (display, HK$1,180), Facet Cabinet in grey (Good, HK$980), and HAY tabletop: La Pittura, Barro, the Ellipse tray and the Bottoms Up vase. Tabletop pages show the selling price only. Rice Paper Shade Ø50 and the Common Pendant Cord Set in Beton Grey have found a new home. Colour Crates (S, M and one XL) and two Tin Containers are in stock, brand new. Ice Cube Tray XXL in Ice blue and Ice Cube Tray Square XL in Peach stay in stock.
- [Herman Miller](https://tacktackstudio.com/brand/herman-miller/): Herman Miller Story Bookcase in Sky, designed by Afteroom (Chen-Yen Wei and Hung-Ming Chen) in 2017. One pole, nine floating shelves, a footprint of about 40 × 40 cm. Books stack on their sides. Brand new, open for pre-order at HK$3,880.
- [Ring-a-Date](https://tacktackstudio.com/brand/ring-a-date/): Perpetual wall calendars and coloured ring sets. In stock in Hong Kong: White, Green and Orange calendars at HK$1,380, the Café Mousse Limited Edition at HK$1,580, and ring sets of 3 in Broom Yellow, Neon Green, Warm Red and Pumpkin Orange at HK$128. Brand new, with box for the calendars. Buy on WhatsApp.

## Designers
- [Isamu Noguchi](https://tacktackstudio.com/designer/isamu-noguchi/): A sculptor who taught paper to hold light.
- [Verner Panton](https://tacktackstudio.com/designer/verner-panton/): Colour, curves and a lamp that still makes people smile.
- [Yoshitomo Nara](https://tacktackstudio.com/designer/yoshitomo-nara/): Sweet, a little defiant, and impossible to ignore.

## Questions
- Where can I buy AKARI lamps in Hong Kong? Tack, tack! stocks curated new and pre-loved Isamu Noguchi AKARI in Hong Kong. The 30A, 45D and 55D have sold. Enquire on WhatsApp (+852 6507 0791) or email hello@tacktackstudio.com. Pickup is by appointment, or we deliver in Hong Kong.
- Which DULTON Double Face colour is in stock in Hong Kong? Grey is in stock in Hong Kong. A green clock has found a new home. Green and black are open to pre-order, brand new. WhatsApp us (+852 6507 0791).
- Where can I buy Yoshitomo Nara prints in Hong Kong? Tack, tack! has two brand-new prints: Green Eyes (2002) at HK$298 and Untitled (Eye Patch) (2012) at HK$328. Both are 28 × 36 cm, unframed. Enquire on WhatsApp (+852 6507 0791).
- How does WhatsApp buying work? Message us with the piece name or link. We confirm availability and send photos, then you pay by FPS, PayMe, bank transfer or cash (PayPal for overseas buyers). Pickup is by appointment, or we quote delivery. There's no online checkout.
- 香港哪裡可以買 AKARI 燈？ Tack, tack! 有精選全新及二手野口勇 AKARI，30A、45D 及 55D 已售出。WhatsApp（+852 6507 0791）或電郵 hello@tacktackstudio.com 查詢。可預約自取，或香港送貨。
- DULTON 雙面鐘哪個顏色有香港現貨？ 灰色是香港現貨，由日本直送。已售出的綠色已經找到新家。綠色和黑色都可以預購，全新。WhatsApp（+852 6507 0791）。
- 香港哪裡可以買奈良美智海報？ Tack, tack! 現貨兩張全新海報：Green Eyes（2002）HK$298、Untitled (Eye Patch)（2012）HK$328。兩張都是 28 × 36 cm，不連相框。WhatsApp（+852 6507 0791）。
- WhatsApp 怎樣購買？ 傳訊息時註明貨品名稱或連結。我們會確認存貨並傳送相片，然後以 FPS、PayMe、銀行轉帳或現金付款（海外買家可用 PayPal），再安排預約自取或報價送貨。網站不設網上付款。
